messages:
Maya Chen: Hey team — need a quick ops plan to enable the new 'fast-route' flag for ACME (Account: ACME-ENT-42). It's a contract-gated feature for VIPs only. Who can help define the canary slice + kill-switch?
Alex Patel: I'm on it. Do we have the contract id to scope? Also want to confirm fallbacks if the model timeout rises.
Jon Sanders: Contract is CONTRACT-ACME-2026. Suggest starting with 0.5% of sessions for the VIP org, then 5% if stable.
Rachel Nguyen: For canary we usually use per-tenant sampling + rollout key. Example rule in flagstore:
```
{"flag":"fast-route","targets":{"orgs":["ACME-ENT-42"]},"rules":[{"type":"percent","value":0.5}],"contract_gate":"CONTRACT-ACME-2026","kill_switch":"global_disable_fast_route"}
```
Nina Gomez: +1. Ops runbook: 1) enable with 0.5% 2) monitor latency & error-rate for 30m 3) bump to 5% if <0.5% error and p50 increase <20ms 4) full rollout after 24h stable. I'll add the alert thresholds.
Alex Patel: Where does the kill switch live? Is it a per-customer toggle or global?
Maya Chen: We keep both. Primary is per-org allowlist/killkey; secondary is global kill switch for platform-wide incidents. flag-bot: Current state: fast-route = disabled globally; per-org entries = none.
Jon Sanders: I'll push the per-org entry now. Pushing CLI snippet:
```
redwood feature set fast-route --org ACME-ENT-42 --contract CONTRACT-ACME-2026 --percent 0.5
```
Rachel Nguyen: tagging oncall @Nina for alert guidance :eyes: 
Nina Gomez: got it — will add two composite alerts: (1) error-rate for ACME >0.5% over 5m, (2) p50 latency delta >25ms vs baseline for 10m. I'll post the links once created.
Maya Chen: Thanks. After Jon pushes, I'll watch metrics and give the green for bump to 5% if OK. If we hit either alert, we'll execute the kill switch and post incident notes.
Jon Sanders: Done — set 0.5% entry in feature store. flag-bot: Update: fast-route per-org ACME-ENT-42 = 0.5% (contract: CONTRACT-ACME-2026).
Alex Patel: Nice. Quick QA question — do we need to notify account team / CSM before canary?
Maya Chen: Yes, cc @Rachel Nguyen to notify ACME CSM and ask them to be on stand-by. Rachel, can you ping them?
Rachel Nguyen: pinged ACME CSM (Jared) — they're aware and will be available during bump window. :thumbsup: 
Maya Chen: Great. Closing loop: timeline: now -> 0.5% canary for 30m-1h -> review -> bump to 5% if green. Document any anomalies in the ticket. Thanks everyone.
